description: The claude runner builds its launch command in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/agent_attribution.py (attribution_off_settings) and agent_runner.py (the claude runner build_cmd). When the settings value it is given is inline JSON, it is returned as inline JSON and placed on the command line as the argument of --settings. That JSON carries an env block with CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, so the long-lived token sits in the argument vector of the in-container claude process for the whole turn and is readable by any local user through ps or docker top (a resolver container was observed doing this). Only a settings value that already came from a file is moved to a private temp file today.
goal: The token never appears in any process argument vector. attribution_off_settings returns a path to a private temp file (mode 600, created with tempfile.mkstemp, removed at exit, cached per content as today) whenever the merged settings carry a non-empty env mapping, for inline JSON as well as for file input; settings with no env block may stay inline. The claude runner passes that path to --settings, so the command line holds a path and never the token. The echo padding entry inside the settings content is kept as is. Add tests that build the claude command with an inline settings value carrying a fake token and assert the token string appears in no element of the argument vector, that the file is mode 600 and holds the merged settings (attribution off, code-mode default env, the original env), and that file input behaves as before.
rationale: A credential on a command line is world-readable on a shared host; passing it by a private file keeps it off ps and docker top while claude still receives the same settings.
acceptance_criteria: With HOLON_AGENT_SETTINGS set to inline JSON whose env holds a fake token, the argument vector built by the claude runner contains no element that includes the token value; the --settings argument is a path to an existing file whose content is valid JSON with the token in env and attribution disabled.
The settings temp file is created with mode 600, is removed at interpreter exit and is reused for identical content.
Settings input given as a file, settings without an env block and an unset value behave as before; existing tests pass or are updated only where they asserted the inline form.
The module line budgets are frozen: do not edit holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or any budget-check script, and keep every touched module within its current budget.
uv run pytest passes for the touched test files, and uv run task lint and uv run task lint-docs pass.
